title: Employer-ref count-cap rejection message on the same Documents step still uses the pre-sweep term "employer reference"
evidence:
use _ <- result.try(check_cap(
          employer_ref_count,
          max_employer_ref,
          "One employer reference per adult \u{2014} that\u{2019}s four at most.",
        ))
detail: Reachable when total employer-ref uploads exceed 4 (crafted multi-file post; slots are multiple:False but precheck_uploads enforces server-side). Every sibling message on this step now says "employer / business reference" (diff: upload_required_message, error_summary labels, slot labels); this branch was not updated and is not in the disclosed left-untouched list.
recommended_fix: Reword to "One employer / business reference per adult — that's four at most." or add the surface to the PR's disclosed deferred list for a user ruling.

title: New validation test appends a duplicate num_occupants key; first-match-wins get_form_value silently keeps the base "1", so the constructed 2-adult household never exists
detail: list.key_find returns the first match, so the appended "2" is dead; the test runs num_occupants=1 alongside co_applicant_count=1 — an inconsistent household that passes only because validate_form performs no occupancy/co-applicant cross-check. Assertions pass today, but the tested state diverges from the constructed one.
recommended_fix: Replace list.append for num_occupants with list.key_set("num_occupants", "2") so the intended household size is the one actually validated.
